text: G, answering minervini and livermore: keep h1_close_above:bar_high. This is a test of the broken level, a double stop point (C20): D close_vs_swing_high_pct 1.74 over last_swing_high 41.91, and H1 pos_in_day_range_pct 2.3 is the pullback onto it. The H1 close over the bar high is the trigger after the test, not anticipation; a daily close waits a session and buys further from the tested level (C20, C18). Wrong if close_below:structure_shift_ref-0.5atr or structure_shift turns BEARISH_CHOCH. I move if D closes back under 41.91 first. Volume is not my test. SUPPORT.
